title: Orion and Osiris symbolism in the Apollo patch

tellings.quote: But, look again. Behind the A is the constellation Orion. And the crossbar of the A is deliberately aligned with Orion's belt.

plain: Hidden in the Apollo programme patch of the 1960s, behind the letter A, is the constellation Orion, with the crossbar of the A deliberately lined up with Orion's belt, a star group ancient Egyptians tied to the god Osiris. Michels points this out himself, reading the patch as a sign that NASA's moon programme carried pagan symbolism on purpose.
